A couple quality-of-life suggestions that would be useful for verses where people may not want to see all the content:

 

1

I know I requested the JS removal from the sidebar a while ago for security reasons, but maybe you could add some default scripts so we can use flair filters in the sidebar.

This is my previous script for showing/hiding that I use in the sidebar, so users can hide certain post types: [Weekly Discussion](javascript:$('.flairdisc').parents('.submission').toggle();void(0))
(flairdisc is the name of the Discussion flair)

 

It should be reasonably easy to add a secondary link type that allows admins to insert this function. For example:
{Weekly Discussion}(flairdisc)
to convert into the code shown above (with proper sanitizing of course to prevent exploits).

 

You could go further by allowing full access to that api, but I'm not sure if it would be useful for anything. And if you did that you'd want to make sure to allow full range of prefixes e.g. # so all element types can be referenced: {Weekly Discussion}(.flairdisc)(.submission)

 

Note: Reddit allows something similar but it's through a search filter, so it's a lot more clunky

 

2

Automated post flair. If a thread is submitted with the title "[News] World Trade Center Attack", voat should check to see if "news" is a flair on that verse, and apply it to the post (and preferably remove [News] from the title in the process).

Alternately you could allow mods to edit post titles so they can manually flair and fix the title, but an automated process would be better.

 

Note: Reddit does this through automoderator scripting
